# Game Idea

**Asteroid Rush**

- Play as a small ship navigating an endless field of moving asteroids on an HTML canvas.
- Use rotation and thrust to dodge obstacles; each collision ends the game (lose condition).
- Survive as long as possible to rack up a distance‑based score.

1: // Simple Asteroid Rush game
2: // Assumes an HTML canvas with id="game" is present and this script is loaded.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10: 
11:   // Ship
12:   const ship = {
13:     x: width / 2,
14:     y: height / 2,
15:     angle: 0,
16:     radius: 10,
17:     vx: 0,
18:     vy: 0,
19:     thrust: false,
20:     rotate: 0,
21:   };
22: 
23:   // Starfield for nicer background
24:   const stars = [];
25:   const starCount = 100;
26:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
27:     stars.push({
28:       x: Math.random() * width,
29:       y: Math.random() * height,
30:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
31:     });
32:   }
33: 
34:   // Input handling
35:   // Sound setup
36:   const thrustAudio = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAgD4AAAB9AAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA=');
37:   thrustAudio.loop = true;
38:   thrustAudio.volume = 0.5;
39:   const explosionAudio = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAgD4AAAB9AAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA=');
40:   const bgMusic = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAgD4AAAB9AAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA=');
41:   bgMusic.loop = true;
42:   bgMusic.volume = 0.2;
43:   bgMusic.play();
44:   let thrustPlaying = false;
45:   const keys = {};
46:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.code] = true));
47:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.code] = false));
48: 
49:   // Asteroids
50:   const asteroids = [];
51:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
52:   let lastSpawn = 0;
53:   const maxAsteroids = 30;
54: 
55:   function spawnAsteroid() {
56:     const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
57:     let x, y, dx, dy;
58:     const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 2;
59:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
60:     const radius = 15 + Math.random() * 20;
61:     switch (edge) {
62:       case 0: // top
63:         x = Math.random() * width;
64:         y = -radius;
65:         break;
66:       case 1: // right
67:         x = width + radius;
68:         y = Math.random() * height;
69:         break;
70:       case 2: // bottom
71:         x = Math.random() * width;
72:         y = height + radius;
73:         break;
74:       case 3: // left
75:         x = -radius;
76:         y = Math.random() * height;
77:         break;
78:     }
79:     dx = Math.cos(angle) * speed;
80:     dy = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
81:     asteroids.push({ x, y, dx, dy, radius });
82:   }
83: 
84:   let collisionHandled = false;
85: function update(dt) {
86:     // Ship controls
87:     ship.rotate = 0;
88:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.rotate = -0.05;
89:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.rotate = 0.05;
90:     ship.angle += ship.rotate;
91:     ship.thrust = keys['ArrowUp'];
92:     if (ship.thrust) {
93:       const thrustPower = 0.1;
94:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * thrustPower;
95:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * thrustPower;
96:     }
97:     // Thrust sound handling
98:     if (ship.thrust && !thrustPlaying) {
99:       thrustAudio.play();
100:       thrustPlaying = true;
101:     } else if (!ship.thrust && thrustPlaying) {
102:       thrustAudio.pause();
103:       thrustAudio.currentTime = 0;
104:       thrustPlaying = false;
105:     }
106:     // Apply friction
107:     ship.vx *= 0.99;
108:     ship.vy *= 0.99;
109:     ship.x += ship.vx;
110:     ship.y += ship.vy;
111:     // Wrap ship around edges
112:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += width;
113:     if (ship.x > width) ship.x -= width;
114:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y += height;
115:     if (ship.y > height) ship.y -= height;
116: 
117:     // Asteroids movement and spawn
118:     const now = performance.now();
119:     if (now - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval && asteroids.length < maxAsteroids) {
120:       spawnAsteroid();
121:       lastSpawn = now;
122:     }
123:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
124:       const a = asteroids[i];
125:       a.x += a.dx;
126:       a.y += a.dy;
127:       // Wrap asteroids
128:       if (a.x < -a.radius) a.x = width + a.radius;
129:       if (a.x > width + a.radius) a.x = -a.radius;
130:       if (a.y < -a.radius) a.y = height + a.radius;
131:       if (a.y > height + a.radius) a.y = -a.radius;
132:     }
133:   }
134: 
135:   function drawShip() {
136:     ctx.save();
137:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
138:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
139:     // Ship body
140:     ctx.beginPath();
141:     ctx.moveTo(12, 0);
142:     ctx.lineTo(-8, -8);
143:     ctx.lineTo(-8, 8);
144:     ctx.closePath();
145:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
146:     ctx.fill();
147:     // Thrust flame
148:     if (ship.thrust) {
149:       ctx.beginPath();
150:       ctx.moveTo(-8, -4);
151:       ctx.lineTo(-14, 0);
152:       ctx.lineTo(-8, 4);
153:       ctx.closePath();
154:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
155:       ctx.fill();
156:     }
157:     ctx.restore();
158:   }
159: 
160:   function drawAsteroids() {
161:     // Asteroids with simple shading
162:     for (const a of asteroids) {
163:       const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(
164:         a.x, a.y, a.radius * 0.2,
165:         a.x, a.y, a.radius
166:       );
167:       gradient.addColorStop(0, '#bbb');
168:       gradient.addColorStop(1, '#555');
169:       ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
170:       ctx.beginPath();
171:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
172:       ctx.fill();
173:     }
174:   }
175: 
176:   function checkCollision() {
177:     for (const a of asteroids) {
178:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
179:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
180:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
181:       if (dist < a.radius + ship.radius) return true;
182:     }
183:     return false;
184:   }
185: 
186:   let startTime = null;
187:   let gameOver = false;
188:   let score = 0;
189: 
190:   function drawStars() {
191:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
192:     for (const s of stars) {
193:       ctx.beginPath();
194:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
195:       ctx.fill();
196:     }
197:   }
198: 
199: function loop(timestamp) {
200:     if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
201:     const dt = timestamp - (startTime + score);
202:     if (!gameOver) {
203:       update(dt);
204:       if (checkCollision()) gameOver = true;
205:     }
206:     // Draw
207:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
208:     drawStars();
209:     drawShip();
210:     drawAsteroids();
211:     // Score
212:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
213:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
214:     const elapsed = ((timestamp - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
215:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${elapsed}s`, 10, 20);
216:     if (gameOver) {
217:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
218:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
219:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 120, height / 2);
220:     } else {
221:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
222:     }
223:   }
224: 
225:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
226: })();

(End of file - total 226 lines)
</content>
